text:
alex: master CI red on macos-smoke. saw a bunch of include order/duplicate symbol errors after the gcc13 toolchain roll. cc @eng-infra

ci-bot: build failed - https://ci.redwood.example/2358001234 :x: macos-12-smoke

maria: logs?

alex: pasted relevant compile error:
```
In file included from src/core/stream.cc:12:
/opt/toolchain/include/some_header.h:12: error: conflicting declaration 'Foo'
ld: duplicate symbol _ZN4foo... in libbar.a and libbaz.a
```

sam: saw similar in a downstream project earlier. maybe header order got stricter with -isystem changes

raj: can someone bisect? suspect the toolchain image change at 2357920000

kate: i can't repro locally on macos-ventura with local gcc13 image, but CI uses macos-12 image. different clang/libstdc++ combo

maria: can you rerun the flaky shard with no remote cache? quick rerun requested

alex: requested rerun: https://ci.redwood.example/rerun/2358001234?nocache=1 :thumbsup:

ci-bot: rerun queued. note: we'll only rerun shard 7 (the one that failed)

sam: if rerun still fails, let's try building with -DWINIGNORE=off jk. hmm.

raj: setting up a fast bisect job. if rerun fails i'll start bisect across toolchain images and cc you all

kate: FYI i submitted a small change earlier that reorders includes in stream.cc, but it passed tests on linux

maria: if bisect points to toolchain bump, we'll rollback the image in CI while infra investigates

alex: thanks. ping here when rerun completes or bisect starts.

ci-bot: rerun finished: failed (same errors) https://ci.redwood.example/2358001234/console

raj: starting bisect job now, ETA ~30m

kate: adding a quick patch that includes header A before B to test whether order masks the problem

sam: note: keep this small and mark as temporary in PR description

ci-bot: bisect progress: good until 2357924321, bad at 2357926789 -> likely toolchain delta

maria: confirm rollback of the macos-12 image for smoke to previous image 2357924321. filing infra ticket

alex: created infra ticket INFRA-542: rollback macos-12 smoke image

maria: rolling changes now, will watch CI

ci-bot: rollback applied, new run started

ci-bot: smoke run after rollback PASSED :white_check_mark:

alex: great — root cause is the toolchain roll. infra, please keep the image pinned until we have a fix. thanks everyone :tada:

maria: will follow up with postmortem and test matrix to exercise macos-12 combo
